# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It's 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh and Qi2-certified 15W wireless charging. It lists for $54.99 on Anker's site.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery. They say it feels premium and runs cooler than competitors.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**Best slim with more capacity and faster charging: INIU SnapGo Air 10K (Qi2.2, 25W)**
- It's 0.5" thick and 195g, with 10,000mAh. The iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2, and this bank also does 45W wired and includes a lanyard-style 60W cable.
- Android Central found it good value at about $43 on Amazon. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe battery.
- Details and buy links: [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) and [Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)**
- It's 0.27" thick and 104g, but wireless charging tops out at 7.5W, so it's slower than the others. Android Central lists it at $69.99 but shows it at $52.99 on Amazon.
- [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Other options from the same review**
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K, 15W):** 0.57" thick and 195g, with IP54 dust and water resistance. It costs about $70-80.
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K, 15W):** 0.35" thick and 119g, with a semi-solid-state battery. It costs about $50.

## How to choose
- **Pocketability first:** Get the Anker Nano 5K. A 5K bank typically adds about 60-75% charge, according to Macworld.
- **A full recharge or more:** Get the INIU SnapGo Air 10K. A 10K bank can charge a phone close to twice.
- **Speed:** Only iPhone 16 and later get 25W Qi2.2. The 15W banks charge the iPhone 17 at 15W.
- **Case:** Use a MagSafe-compatible case. Anker notes that thick or non-magnetic cases can interfere with charging.

Prices come from the search results and may have changed. I couldn't verify current prices or stock.
